_readme: Single source of truth for every number plotted by make_plots.py in this folder. Edit values here, rerun:  python3 info/plots/make_plots.py
_revision: 2026-09-10: A23 (K3-1 phantom-modality guard, all five SAILOR caches rebuilt) and A24 (K3-2 same-space arm rows; K3-11 split_gate with paired bootstrap CIs). Updated: sailor_transfer, sailor_gap_bins, sailor_reprocessed, betfix_decider, coral, site_shift, site_shift_aligned, three_way_shift, fourth_cloud; added split_gate. STILL PRE-REBUILD (needs refit, not re-encode): gauntlet_probe (field_models.pt) and sailor_gap_bins.field_cond/field_uncond (field_scores.pt).

hero_leg1.source: info/pilot.md Run 4 — hero leg 1, full cohort on Kaggle T4 (reported epochs only; no full per-epoch log was kept)

hero_leg2.source: info/pilot.md Run 5 — resume best.pt at LR 2e-5, 30 epochs (reported epochs)

run6.source: info/pilot.md Run 6 + re-gate (aux fine-tune, 10 epochs at 5e-6); F1 from frozen states_forecast-mlp probes
run6.sota_source: Tikhonov et al. arXiv:2509.06511 (ResNet-18 + radiomics -> CatBoost, patient-wise 5-fold CV)

sailor_transfer.source: A23 rebuild + A24 K3-2 same-space fix of A12 — frozen champion, zero SAILOR training; 243 valid pairs / 240 RANO-labelled. (a)-row is EMA-target space on both sides (scripts/sailor_eval.py --pairs).

sailor_gap_bins.source: A23 rebuild 2026-09-10 from checkpoints/sailor_cache.pt (states) + checkpoints/sailor_z_cache.pt (endpoints) + champion 1-step predictor, same target space both sides (EMA). Bins from scripts/sailor_interval_eval.py; gap_head refreshed via scripts/sailor_gap_probe.py. field_* still from pre-rebuild field_scores.pt (A15 refit pending).
sailor_gap_bins.gap_head_source: scripts/sailor_gap_probe.py --head checkpoints/probe_head.pt (LUMIERE-trained probe, zero SAILOR training)
sailor_gap_bins.field_source: checkpoints/field_scores.pt held-out 1-step scores rebinned by pair gap (same 88/20/129/6 pairs); cond=treatment phase, uncond=constant phase

raw_mni.source: scripts/raw_mni_deltas.py full 27-subject run (checkpoints/raw_mni_deltas.pt); mean|delta| on 96^3, z-scored within mask; 243 linked pairs, 939 pair-slots, 33 dropped. Total pipeline effect (upper bound), not PLHM-alone.

coral.source: Freezing battery, CORAL alignment (fold-wise honest: fit on train folds, apply to held-out; z and states spaces; frozen LUMIERE head scored, zero training, zero unfreezing). Rebuilt 2026-09-10 against the A23 field_cache. Fold 4 flat, 4/5 improve.

site_shift.method: PCA via torch SVD on mean-centered per-visit fused (1152-d) latents, both cohorts pooled; frozen champion caches (probe_cache, rebuilt sailor_cache), 2026-09-10.

site_shift_aligned.method: Same pooled-PCA protocol as site_shift, but SAILOR fused visits first CORAL-mapped (transductive fit-all, eps 1e-2) into LUMIERE geometry. Visualization only. 2026-09-10.

sailor_reprocessed.source: A23 rebuild (K3-1 guard) + A24 K3-2 same-space fix of A19: SAILOR raw through executed-LUMIERE pipeline (config/sailor_reprocess.yaml, 1065/1066 vols); evals scripts/sailor_interval_eval.py + scripts/sailor_eval.py --root data/sailor_reprocessed, frozen champion_0.0081, zero training. dynamics_* = same-space (a); transfer/ceiling/surprise from logs_rebuild_eval_reproc.log
sailor_reprocessed.audit: pair/gap/label accounting exact (27/270/243, gaps identical, PD-rate 0.312); hd-bet 2.x unrunnable (no torchvision by policy) so executed contract used percentile fallback on full-head SAILOR raws (nzfrac med 0.49 vs LUMIERE 0.17, skull retained); sub-07/ses-03 CT1 reg-failed + T1/FLAIR near-empty (2 pairs); sidecar .txt ferried from derivatives (intervals/RANO/treatment/age)

three_way_shift.method: Pooled PCA (torch SVD, mean-centered) over per-visit fused latents from three caches: LUMIERE probe_cache, SAILOR-derivatives sailor_cache, SAILOR skull-in sailor_reprocessed_cache. Frozen champion throughout. Rebuilt 2026-09-10.

betfix_decider.source: A23 rebuild (K3-1 guard) from current tree: scripts/sailor_eval.py --eval + scripts/sailor_interval_eval.py --root data/sailor_reprocessed_bet (real HD-BET, isolated venv); frozen champion, zero training. Pre-rebuild ceiling<transfer anomaly RESOLVED (ceiling 0.79 > transfer 0.23) but transfer drops below majority; old 0.32 not reproducible from the tree (sub-07 phantoms ruled out; provenance gap K3-31).

fourth_cloud.method: Pooled PCA over per-visit fused latents, all four caches (LUMIERE probe_cache, derivatives sailor_cache, skull-in sailor_reprocessed_cache, skull-out sailor_betfix_cache). Frozen champion. Rebuilt 2026-09-10.

gauntlet_probe.source: scripts/pred_latent_probe.py --probe (train-stat standardized MLP probes; A9 protocol otherwise); error context = cosine err on the same labelled pairs; field = SAILOR-fit uncond (cond 0.0035 ties 0.0036). PRE-REBUILD: uses field_models.pt/A22 refit from the pre-A23 field_cache; refit pending. Full log: /tmp/opencode/full_probe.log

split_gate.source: A24 K3-11: scripts/split_gate.py over checkpoints/horizon_cache.pt, champion predictor, EMA-target same-space both sides; 10k patient-cluster bootstrap, seed 42. Reproduces the K3-11 point estimates; all JEPA/persist CIs overlap.
split_gate.paired_diff_note: JEPA minus persist (positive = JEPA worse). Only significant cells: train pooled +0.0017 (JEPA significantly WORSE, regression-to-mean tax) and test patient-uniform -0.0086 (JEPA better, but fragile: 13 patients, inflated persist from few-pair dynamic patients). Test pooled mean and overall are n.s.
